name: New York County, NY
findings: New York County has 18,799 nonprofit organizations. 7,499 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6,503 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, New York County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in New York County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 576 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
